# Aggregate/service replication indexes

Historical source inspection. Superseded on 2026-10-02 by [plan 030](../archive/plans/030-plan-remove-replicas-and-service-subscriptions.md); the replica and subscription machinery described below has been deleted.

Source inspection on 2026-10-01. This distinguishes current working-tree code from historical tests; no tests were executed and no implementation changes were made.

`services.lastIndex` tracks the source service's `executedIndex`, the merged command/receipt result order. It does not track `serviceIndex` command admission order: [receiver mapping](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/receiveServiceResults.ts#L175), [service head fields](../../packages/system-worker/src/ServiceVersionRepo/serviceVersionRepoDbConfig.ts#L20).

1. **The aggregate already retains a stream index outside model rows.** Its internal `services` table has `(serviceName, lastIndex)`; activation seeds each declared dependency at zero, and fanout uses that value as the current receiving index. Service version comes from the aggregate's authored service pin. Sources: [table](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/aggregateVersionRepoDbConfig.ts#L23), [initialization](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/onDOActivation/onDOActivation.ts#L50), [subscriber](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/AggregateVersionRepo.ts#L105).

2. **Stream progress and row snapshot progress have different meanings today.** `receiveServiceResults` skips a result at or behind `services.lastIndex`, rejects a gap, and advances `lastIndex` in the same transaction as applied operations and receipts. It applies only explicitly enrolled rows and separately skips a row already covered by `sourceResultPosition`. Row frontiers advance after all operations in a result so two operations affecting one row both apply. Sources: [stream guards](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/receiveServiceResults.ts#L33), [enrolled-row guard](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/receiveServiceResults.ts#L81), [row frontier](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/receiveServiceResults.ts#L119), [stream frontier](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/receiveServiceResults.ts#L148).

3. **The row position represents snapshot coverage, not its last modification.** Service snapshots atomically capture requested rows and the materializer's `head.executedIndex`. Aggregate preparation attaches that common position to every returned row and rejects a snapshot behind the already consumed stream position. It permits a snapshot ahead of that position. Sources: [snapshot transaction](../../packages/system-worker/src/ServiceVersionRepo/getReplicatedResources/getReplicatedResources.ts#L65), [receiver comparison](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/getReplicatedResources/getReplicatedResources.ts#L214), [attached row position](../../packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/getReplicatedResources/getReplicatedResources.ts#L235).

4. **Why the stream cursor alone is insufficient under that enrollment design:** suppose the aggregate consumed service position 10 and enrolls a row from a fresh snapshot covering position 12. Its stream cursor must remain 10 so positions 11 and 12 can still update previously enrolled rows. Those same results must not overwrite the newly enrolled row with older state. The current per-row guard supplies that distinction. This scenario is an inference from the snapshot and receiving code in findings 2–3; eliminating the distinction requires changing enrollment or storing snapshot coverage elsewhere.

5. **Historical tests support the distinction but are deleted locally.** At commit `59b9f146275e02984cb4dc54f2c7a6208c7577d7`, snapshot tests accept a snapshot covering 12 with receiving cursor 10 or 12, reject cursor 13, and assert snapshot preparation leaves the stream cursor unchanged. Receiving tests assert multiple same-row operations apply, a later failed write rolls the whole result back, duplicates are ignored, and empty results advance the source cursor without allocating a local receipt. These are historical test assertions, not current passing tests. Sources: [snapshot cases](https://github.com/morgs32/zerospin/blob/59b9f146275e02984cb4dc54f2c7a6208c7577d7/packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/getReplicatedResources/getReplicatedResources.node.spec.ts#L64-L80), [snapshot and cursor assertions](https://github.com/morgs32/zerospin/blob/59b9f146275e02984cb4dc54f2c7a6208c7577d7/packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/getReplicatedResources/getReplicatedResources.node.spec.ts#L157-L195), [receiving assertions](https://github.com/morgs32/zerospin/blob/59b9f146275e02984cb4dc54f2c7a6208c7577d7/packages/system-worker/src/AggregateVersionRepo/receiveServiceResults.node.spec.ts#L158-L211). These tests do not demonstrate the entire snapshot-ahead backlog race end to end.

6. **The requested replica API can keep transport progress outside business rows, but deletion alone is insufficient.** Current `makeReplica` adds `sourceResultPosition` to its row schema. A proposed aggregate-to-service replica using ordered replay from its own stream checkpoint can avoid independently enrolling snapshots ahead of the cursor; if it supports such snapshots, it needs equivalent coverage metadata or aligned enrollment. These are design implications, not implemented behavior. Sources: [current replica schema](../../packages/core/src/models/make/makeReplica.ts#L52), findings 2–4. The service already declares internal `sourceProgress(sourceKey, resultPosition, enrollmentFrontier)`, independently of replica rows: [schema](../../packages/system-worker/src/ServiceVersionRepo/serviceVersionRepoDbConfig.ts#L29).

7. **The working tree is incomplete and changed during the investigation.** At inspection, `ServiceVersionRepo.receiveAggregateResults` validates and decodes operations, then returns without applying changes or recording progress; its transactional imports remain unused. Consequently these findings explain inspected source logic and historical test assertions, not verified runnable behavior of the full current checkout. Source: [aggregate-result receiver](../../packages/system-worker/src/ServiceVersionRepo/receiveAggregateResults.ts#L36).
